newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela PdVSA oil bonds to have 12.75 pct coupon.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela PdVSA oil bonds to have 12.75 pct coupon.

text.p: Venezuelan state oil company PdVSA will launch Thursday it first issue of oil-backed bonds with a 12.75 percent coupon, PdVSA subsidiary SOFIP said.

Up to 30 billion bolivars ($63 million) of the three-year par bonds will be issued, with first priority given to local investors buying between 100,000 and one million bolivars ($210 to $2,100) of the paper.

The bonds -- designed to encourage wider popular participation in Venezuela's oil industry as well as boosting the development of capital markets -- are the first such to be issued in PdVSa's history.
Under the program, a total of 60 billion bolivars ($126 million) of bonds can be issued -- a figure dwarfed by PdVSA's annual $6.5 billion investment plans.
